minimum_existing_inputs: Existing ordinary LOCAL Store and installed schema32, exact DB binding, no Native/isolated/formal/Run assignment fallback.
Existing bounded strict SYNTHETIC pack and private journal at pinned absolute paths, valid pack window, exact original preparation_catalog hash/xmin; journal only input binding.

Existing owner/reviewer/executor references and current required READ/PREPARE/REVIEW_ASSIGNED/EXECUTE, original same-domain participants and original resource READ/HOLD where actual selected service requires P2; no new permissions.
New explicit mode plus existing LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_DEMO profile/config; exact per-process ordinary service+demo+catalog+selector same Store and catalog identity; old modes remain separate.
Original current parent/material/request, original selection proof and explicit ADOPT/VERIFY/business commands; selected mappings checked against actual outcomes.
One original managed transaction/callback owner for all relevant selection/plan/business consumers; current source/integrity/authority checks after final waits and durable first deadline not reset.
Restart recreates dependencies from current existing inputs and durable rows, not fixture issuer nonce/object lifetime; no setup side effects at serve.
required_guard_notes: Current baseline deliberately rejects the composition in api.create_app, from_environment and _unmixed; new mode must be explicit and exact, rather than deleting old guards.
Plain catalog connection is an actual composition integration point: accepted ordinary P3/P4 sources require managed _checks in all planning/selection/ADOPT consumers.
History and stopping contexts must retain original least permission behavior; active mapping checks cannot be applied indiscriminately to historical reads.

Existing demo catalog validation pins pack/journal/DB/schema/catalog, but only validate(c,parent) binds current parent, and snapshot/current_mapping_states perform participant/resource mapping; these concerns are not interchangeable.
